title: lupinus latifolius var. simplex
intro: Lupinus latifolius var. simplex, commonly known as Broad-leaved Lupine, is a plant species in the legume family, known for its showy, purple flowers and long, narrow leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus latifolius var. simplex are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include isoflavones, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified in various studies.
